label: Bible Study
prompt: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her _____ by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
verse: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
note: A tree that doesn't panic in drought — 'careful' here is KJV for worried.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and _____, saith the Lord Almighty.
verse: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
note: God promises to be a Father — and makes a point of including both sons and daughters.

label: Sunday School
prompt: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by _____ land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
verse: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
note: The Red Sea crossing in one line: Israel walked through on dry land; the Egyptians tried it and drowned.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and _____, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
verse: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
note: Gentiles once outside the fence are now citizens and household — Paul piles on the welcome.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious _____ of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
verse: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
note: 'That blessed hope, and the glorious appearing' — the Second Coming, as Paul framed it for Titus on Crete.
